install.notes: The clone has no setup.py or pyproject.toml and is not installed by this package. It is the content of the ScopeFoundryHW plug-in directory ScopeFoundryHW/acton_spec, so the operator places it there or copies acton_spec_interface.py onto PYTHONPATH. The serial interface imports pyserial (acton_spec_interface.py:1); the ScopeFoundry component also imports ScopeFoundry and numpy (acton_spec.py:9-15). Nothing is downloaded or installed by the acceptance gate.
